biotools.summary: FISH-Dist is an automated computational pipeline designed to accurately quantify spatial distances between fluorescent signals in 3D fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) microscopy. It specifically addresses chromatic aberration using deep learning and Gaussian fitting for robust, sub-pixel accuracy in short-range genomic measurements.
